summary: Two-story BLM lookout in Mohave County, Arizona, built 1981 and NHLR-registered in 2022; sources disagree on the county spelling and the coordinates.

facts.agency: Bureau of Land Management (Arizona Strip District)

events.note: Built year 1981 on the Register entry
Registered May 15, 2022 as US 1574, AZ 78; nominated by Wade Luther

evidence.quote: A unique 2 story BLM lookout design

evidence.supports: administered by the Bureau of Land Management
evidence.quote: Department of the Interior - Bureau of Land Management

evidence.supports: operated by the BLM Arizona Strip District Office

evidence.quote: Black Rock Lookout - 2021 - courtesy of Wade Luther

evidence.supports: inventory lists Black Rock in Mohave, 2-story cab, standing, US 1574, AZ 78, at 36.77328 -113.80833
evidence.quote: Black Rock Mohave 36.77328 -113.80833 2-Story Cab Standing NHLR US 1574, AZ 78

evidence.supports: Mojave County is a different county, in California
evidence.quote: not to be confused with Mojave County, California

evidence.supports: Mohave County occupies the northwestern corner of Arizona
evidence.quote: occupies the northwestern corner of the U.S. state of Arizona

corrections.why: Arizona's county is Mohave County. Mojave County is in California. The Register page uses the California spelling.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register uses Mojave; the inventory and Wikipedia use Mohave. Story uses Mohave.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates disagree: NHLR 36.792819, -113.751968 (the brief's lat/lon) vs inventory 36.77328, -113.80833. Left unresolved and the story says so. Brief's county 'Mojave' proposed as 'Mohave'. A search summary described an older 2011 inventory listing (Semi-Active, R-6 flat design, 10 ft height); I could not find it on any fetched page, so it is not used. A westlookouts page gives the legal description 39N-14W-12; not used. No access information found in any source.
